summary: L11 PHASE-WIDE re-run broader than the G-CORE-9 FREEZE subset. The FREEZE-subset L11 (R1→R4) CONVERGED-PER-Q5 at R4 (lens output at commit 0a3232fb; 1 MINOR closed at R4-FP commit a0b75637) and verified the 10 surfaces enumerated in docs/V1-WIRE-FORMAT-INVENTORY.md. This PHASE-WIDE run widens to every CBOR/DAG-CBOR/on-disk-format encode/decode site across the touched crates per R6-LENS-CATALOG.md §L11 'Surfaces' definition. The phase-wide sweep enumerated 44 production source files containing `to_canonical_bytes` / `serde_ipld_dagcbor::to_vec` / equivalent canonical-bytes call sites across 9 crates (benten-core, benten-crypto-suite, benten-caps, benten-drop, benten-id, benten-engine, benten-eval, benten-graph, benten-platform-foundation, benten-sync). 10 of those map to V1-WIRE-FORMAT-INVENTORY.md items 1-10; ~14 distinct ADDITIONAL wire-format-bearing surfaces are NOT enumerated in the inventory + NOT named in V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE-DEFERRED.md Row D-9 (which only enumerates the 8-surface FREEZE subset). EVERY un-enumerated surface verified to have SUBSTANTIVE coverage at HEAD (round-trip + format-version-discriminator + behavioral pins; ground-truth grep + test-file inspection) — so the L11 lens question 'each has a byte-pin test in the corpus' is answered AFFIRMATIVELY in the substantive sense for every surface checked. The gap is INVENTORY-DOCUMENTATION-INCOMPLETE, not COVERAGE-MISSING: the inventory doc + D-9 deferral row collectively under-represent the phase-wide wire-format surface area, which (per V1-FROZEN-INTERFACE.md §4 'documented inventory of every wire-format-bearing surface') is a FREEZE-CONTRACT gap. The §4 P-III Ben sign-off question 'Are the 9 covered wire-format surfaces + the deferred MerkleRangeProof surface the COMPLETE v1-beta wire-format inventory?' cannot be answered 'yes, complete' with the inventory in its current shape — at minimum 8-10 additional surfaces need to be added (or D-9 needs to absorb them as named-deferrals with the same posture-narrative: 'roundtrip + format-version pins enforce byte stability at v1-beta; full hex-pinned-bytes regression-defense deferred to G-COMP-1'). Promoting this to MAJOR severity rather than MINOR because: (a) the freeze-contract literal contract item 4 §1 deliverable IS the documented inventory, (b) the §4 P-III Ben decision-point question is structurally un-answerable until the inventory is complete, (c) the inventory's own §'P-III Ben decision-point' section frames the inventory as the Ben-sign-off site per G-CORE-9 R2 L18-r2-4 path (b). Per CLAUDE.md HARD RULE 12 the disposition is FIX-NOW (orchestrator-direct ~30 LOC inventory expansion + ~15 LOC D-9 widening). Two MINOR observations also surfaced (one cite-drift residual in the inventory + one inconsistency between the 2 inventory cell-shapes). Q5 termination test: 1 MAJOR + 2 MINOR → R6 R1 NOT-CONVERGED for this lens; expected to converge after the inventory-expansion fix-pass lands. Pattern note: this is exactly the recurrence-class §3.6j is designed to catch — the FREEZE-subset sweep was self-verified COMPLETE at R3-FP via the 15-cite resolution sweep, but the PHASE-WIDE sweep over the whole production source tree surfaces 14 additional surfaces the inventory didn't enumerate.
